seoTitle: How to Enable Apple Pay in Stripe
metaDescription: Activate Apple Pay in your Stripe dashboard, verify your domain, and add it to your site for faster, more secure checkout.
intro: Apple Pay can speed up checkout significantly for customers on iPhone, iPad, or Mac, and enabling it inside Stripe is a fairly quick setup process. This guide walks through activating Apple Pay in your Stripe dashboard, verifying your domain, and testing the payment flow before going live.

steps.heading: Open your Stripe dashboard
steps.body: Log into Stripe and navigate to the payment methods section where Apple Pay can be enabled.

steps.heading: Verify your domain
steps.body: Complete Stripe's domain verification process so Apple Pay can be used securely on your website.

steps.heading: Connect Apple Pay to your checkout
steps.body: Enable Apple Pay as an available payment method within your Stripe-powered checkout or payment form.

steps.heading: Test the payment flow
steps.body: Run a test transaction using Apple Pay to confirm it works correctly before customers start using it.

steps.heading: Go live
steps.body: Once testing confirms everything works, Apple Pay will be available for customers to use at checkout.

faq.question: Do I need an Apple Developer account to enable Apple Pay in Stripe?
faq.answer: No, Stripe handles the necessary Apple Pay merchant setup for you, so you don't need a separate Apple Developer account.

faq.question: Is domain verification required for Apple Pay?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe requires you to verify your domain before Apple Pay can be used on your website's checkout.

faq.question: Can customers use Apple Pay on Android devices?
faq.answer: No, Apple Pay is exclusive to Apple devices like iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and won't appear as an option for Android users.

faq.question: Does enabling Apple Pay cost extra on Stripe?
faq.answer: Apple Pay transactions are typically processed under your standard Stripe payment fees without additional charges just for enabling it.
